## Review verdict

**37 findings** (4 high / 15 medium / 18 low), plus 1 suppressed. My triage: **8 block**, **19 warn**, **10 ignore**.

One caveat that shapes everything below: `blast_radius`, `blast_radius_importers`, `churn`, and `recency` are **0 on every single finding**. That's an artefact of the framing — the whole repo is one PR on an empty baseline, so there's no history to churn and no pre-existing importers. Read those zeros as "unmeasurable", not "safe". That leaves `severity` and `agent_risk` doing all the work, and `agent_risk` tops out at 0.44 — so I'm not using a flat agent_risk threshold; I'm using it to *promote* low-severity findings that a severity-only read would wave through.

---

## Block merge (8)

| ID | Finding | sev | agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00017` | Hardcoded `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` — `src/api/files.ts:9` | 0.6 | 0.30 | Neither score is the argument — `confidence: 0.9` is. This path exists on exactly one laptop. Every other dev, every CI runner, every deploy fails. Effort `quick`. There is no version of "merge and fix later" that survives the first CI run. |
| `crime_00016` | Hardcoded `localhost:3000` — `src/api/files.ts:8` | 0.6 | 0.30 | Same file, same class, same `quick` effort. Works only against whichever dev server happens to be up. Bundle the fix with 00017. |
| `crime_00010` | Half-UTC, half-local on receiver `d` — `src/date.ts:9,41` | **0.8** | 0.36 | `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()` on the same value. This is silently wrong by the host's UTC offset — it produces plausible dates that are off by one, and it will pass review by eye. High severity + 0.85 confidence + a date module with no tests. |
| `crime_00012` | `new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")`, `new Date("2026-12-20")` — `src/date.ts:29,33` | 0.6 | 0.35 | Only medium alone, but it compounds 00010 in the same file: the module both parses without a zone and mixes zone families. `confidence: 0.9`, effort `small`. Blocking as one date.ts correctness unit. |
| `crime_00001` | 8× `Date.now()`/`new Date()` — `src/date.ts:4–40` | **0.8** | **0.44** | Highest `agent_risk` in the report, and it's why 00010/00012 can't be verified: with 8 unpinned clock reads, you cannot write the test that would have caught the UTC/local bug. `test_gap: 0.5`. Fixing this first makes the other two date blockers provable rather than argued. |
| `crime_00015` | `calculateRefundPreview` calls `saveRefundAudit`, `sendRefundEmail` — `src/billing.ts:40` | 0.55 | 0.31 | The score understates this. A function named `…Preview` that sends customer email and writes an audit row is a live foot-gun: any caller — human or agent — reasonably treats it as a dry run. Real-world side effects on a money path. Renaming is `small` effort. |
| `crime_00005` | `generateInvoice`, 204 lines — `src/billing.ts:50–253` | **0.9** | 0.38 | Highest severity in the report, 3.4× threshold, `confidence: 0.95`. `agent_risk` is only 0.38 because there are no importers *yet* — that's the empty-baseline artefact. This is the one moment the function is cheap to split; a 204-line orchestrator that ships never gets decomposed later. |
| `crime_00025` | Test `"renders the enterprise plan"` has 0 assertions — `src/billing.test.ts:4–6` | 0.45 | 0.27 | Both scores are middling and I'm still blocking. A green test that asserts nothing is worse than no test: it's the artefact reviewers and agents cite as evidence billing is covered. `confidence: 0.88`, effort `small`. Assert or delete. |

**Theme:** the blockers reduce to three files — `src/date.ts` (correctness + untestability), `src/api/files.ts` (environment-portability), `src/billing.ts` (a misleading name on a refund path, an unsplittable function, and a test that proves nothing).

---

## Warn (19)

Land the PR with these tracked. Grouped by what they actually are.

**Agent-facing ambiguity — low severity, disproportionate `agent_risk`.** This is where the scoring model earns its keep; a severity-only review ignores all four.

- `crime_00002` Return Shape Roulette, `resolvePaymentResult` (sev **0.3**, ar **0.43**) — three return shapes, 0% key overlap, no explicit return type. Third-highest agent_risk in the report on a "low" finding. Every caller guesses.
- `crime_00003` Missing Agent Context (sev 0.6, ar **0.42**) — no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md, and `package.json` declares a `bin`. A repo that ships a binary with zero discoverable commands.
- `crime_00008` Sync I/O in `loadPlanSchema` (sev 0.4, ar 0.38) — 3 blocking calls, async counterparts exist for all three.
- `crime_00009` Option Bag Junk Drawer, `describeCheckout` (sev 0.3, ar 0.38) — 6 implicit property reads.

**Multiple sources of truth.** Each is an edit that will go stale in exactly one place:

- `crime_00004` `"enterprise"` in 4 files across 4 areas (sev 0.5, ar 0.42) — this is duplicated *policy*, not a duplicated string.
- `crime_00006` `/settings/billing` labelled `Plans` and `Billing` in two nav files (sev 0.6, ar 0.38).
- `crime_00007` The same route labelled **four** ways — path, component `PricingPage`, `metadata.title: Plans`, `<title>: Subscription` (sev 0.6, ar 0.38).
- `crime_00019` `tenant` concept spelled account/organisation/team/workspace across 5 files (sev 0.55, ar 0.30).

00006 and 00007 are one fix; 00019 explains the three orphan routes below.

**Correctness, deferrable:**

- `crime_00018` `+ 86400000` day math (sev 0.6, ar 0.30) — wrong on DST days. `medium` effort, so it's a follow-up rather than a blocker.
- `crime_00013` 7 clock reads in `billing.ts` (sev 0.6, ar 0.34) — same class as blocker 00001 but lower severity; fold into the clock-injection ticket.
- `crime_00020` **Escalate to block if unconfirmed** — comment at `billing.ts:39`: *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves."* (sev 0.5, ar 0.30, conf 0.71). Sitting directly above `calculateRefundPreview`. If that authorization rule is genuinely nowhere in code, this stops being a documentation nit and becomes a missing check on a refund path. One question to the author resolves it.

**Structure and hygiene:**

- `crime_00035` `billing.ts` 311 lines (sev 0.6, ar 0.18) — only 1.0× threshold; splitting `generateInvoice` (blocker 00005) likely resolves it for free.
- `crime_00014` 14 TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX in `src/todo.ts` at 411.8/1k LOC (sev 0.4, ar 0.32) — 41× threshold. A brand-new file that's mostly unfinished markers.
- `crime_00034` `"creates an invoice"` uses only weak matchers (sev 0.25, ar 0.23) — same file as blocker 00025; fix together.
- `crime_00033` `docs/teams.md:5 → ./setup.md` doesn't exist (sev 0.35, ar 0.24, conf 0.9) — one-line fix, and agents follow doc links.
- `crime_00029/30/31` Three orphan routes — `/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members` (sev 0.4, ar 0.26 each, conf 0.65) — unreachable from nav, docs, or imports. Note these are *exactly* the three tenant-alias routes from 00019; that's not coincidence, it's three half-built versions of one concept. Author confirms in-flight or deletes.
- `crime_00032` SVG with 2 embedded base64 rasters (sev **0.75**, ar 0.24) — the only high-severity finding I'm not blocking. High on asset quality, but `agent_risk 0.24`, no behaviour change, trivially reversible post-merge. Severity alone would over-rank this.

---

## Ignore (10)

Not "wrong" — just below the bar for gating a merge. Style, or already covered by a blocker's fix.

| ID | Finding | sev | agent_risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00011` | Negative Flag Maze, `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` | 0.25 | 0.36 |
| `crime_00022` | Unprefixed booleans `paid`/`expired`/`stale` | 0.3 | 0.29 |
| `crime_00028` | Unprefixed booleans `disableBilling`/`skipRetry` | 0.3 | 0.26 |
| `crime_00023` | 1× `Date.now()` in `state.ts` | 0.35 | 0.28 |
| `crime_00024` | `users: User` / `invoice: Invoice[]` | 0.3 | 0.28 |
| `crime_00026` | Date string concat, `date.ts:41` | 0.3 | 0.26 |
| `crime_00027` | `toLocaleDateString()` with no locale | 0.3 | 0.26 |
| `crime_00036` | 32×32 PNG icon | 0.35 | 0.16 |
| `crime_00037` | 253.9 KB hero banner | 0.4 | **0.14** |
| `crime_00038` | 4 TODOs in `billing.ts` (12.9/1k) | 0.2 | **0.08** |

Reasoning: 00023, 00026, and 00027 all live inside code the date.ts blockers already force you to rewrite — raising them separately is noise. 00011/00022/00028 are naming conventions; 00011 carries a notable ar 0.36 for a 0.25-severity finding, so it's the one I'd promote first if the author is touching `petty.ts` anyway. 00037 is at the very bottom of its own severity ladder (253.9 KB against a 200/500/1000 KB ladder) and 00038 is 12.9 markers/1k against a threshold of 10 — both are threshold grazes with the two lowest agent_risk scores in the report (0.14, 0.08).

---

## What I'd say on the PR

> Four things block: `src/api/files.ts` has a hardcoded home path and a `localhost:3000` URL that break on every machine but yours; `src/date.ts` mixes UTC and local methods on the same value while parsing zone-less strings, with 8 unpinned clock reads that make the bug untestable; `calculateRefundPreview` sends email and writes audit rows; and `generateInvoice` is 204 lines with a billing test that asserts nothing. All but the date work is `small` or `quick` effort.
>
> One question before I can finish the review: is the `billing.ts:39` rule — *only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves* — enforced anywhere in code? If not, that moves to the blocking list.
>
> Also worth a look before merge, though not gating: `/settings/billing` is labelled four different ways across route/component/title/nav, and there are three unreachable routes (`/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members`) that look like three half-built takes on the same "tenant" concept.

One finding was suppressed by config — worth confirming that suppression is intentional rather than inherited.
